issues.detail: Expected result read 'the boundary behavior is clearly and consistently defined, or...' which is a hedge and is not an observable, testable outcome.

coverage_gaps: The design's scenario set (SC-1..SC-21) has no case covering an invalid, tampered, or non-existent reset token, distinct from an expired link (SC-5/SC-9/SC-10) or a reused link (SC-8). Added a new negative test case (TC-009 in the final numbering) to close this gap.
